Includes subdomain URLs in URL map discovery; page has 1 local and 1 subdomain link

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::{map_urls, shutdown_engine};
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"allow_subdomains\":true,\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = map_urls(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    shutdown_engine(engine).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.urls.len());
}
```
